title: Suka explains the strength of the enemy's army to Ravana
introduction: While Rama crossed over to the other shore of the sea, Ravana instructs his ministers, Suka and Sarana to enter the enemy's army in disguise and to bring all the required information about them. When Suka and Sarana entered the enemy's ranks, Vibhishana recognises and captures them. But Rama sets them free. Going back to Ravana, they explain the might strength of the enemy's ranks and exhort him to restore Seetha to Rama.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे पञ्चविंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 25th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
सबले सागरम् तीर्णे रामे दशरथ आत्मजे |
अमात्यौ रावणः श्रीमान् अब्रवीत् शुक सारणौ
verses.iast:
sabale sāgaram tīrṇe rāme daśaratha ātmaje |
amātyau rāvaṇaḥ śrīmān abravīt śuka sāraṇau
verses.translation: While Rama, the son of Dasaratha, crossed the ocean along with his army, the illustrious Ravana spoke to Shuka and Sarana, his ministers as follows:

verses.devanagari:
समग्रम् सागरम् तीर्णम् दुस्तरम् वानरम् बलम् |
अभूत पूर्वम् रामेण सागरे सेतु बन्धनम्
verses.iast:
samagram sāgaram tīrṇam dustaram vānaram balam |
abhūta pūrvam rāmeṇa sāgare setu bandhanam
verses.translation: "The entire army of monkeys crossed the impassable ocean. The construction of the bridge, unprecedented, across the ocean was executed by Rama."

verses.devanagari:
सागरे सेतु बन्धम् तु न श्रद्दध्याम् कथंचन |
अवश्यम् च अपि सम्ख्येयम् तन् मया वानरम् बलम्
verses.iast:
sāgare setu bandham tu na śraddadhyām kathaṃcana |
avaśyam ca api samkhyeyam tan mayā vānaram balam
verses.translation: "I am not able to believe under any circumstances that a pass-way has been constructed across the ocean. Certainly, that army of monkeys is worth to be counted (carried weight) by me."

glosses.meaning: I am not able to believe
is worth to be conduted (carried weight)

verses.devanagari:
भवन्तौ वानरम् सैन्यम् प्रविश्य अनुपलक्षितौ |
परिमाणम् च वीर्यम् च ये च मुख्याः प्लवम् गमाः
मन्त्रिणो ये च रामस्य सुग्रीवस्य च सम्मताः |
ये पूर्वम् अभिवर्तन्ते ये च शूराः प्लवम् गमाः
स च सेतुर् यथा बद्धः सागरे सलिल अर्णवे |
निवेशः च यथा तेषाम् वानराणाम् महात्मनाम्
रामस्य व्यवसायम् च वीर्यम् प्रहरणानि च |
लक्ष्मणस्य च वीरस्य तत्त्वतो ज्ञातुम् अर्हथ
verses.iast:
bhavantau vānaram sainyam praviśya anupalakṣitau |
parimāṇam ca vīryam ca ye ca mukhyāḥ plavam gamāḥ
mantriṇo ye ca rāmasya sugrīvasya ca sammatāḥ |
ye pūrvam abhivartante ye ca śūrāḥ plavam gamāḥ
sa ca setur yathā baddhaḥ sāgare salila arṇave |
niveśaḥ ca yathā teṣām vānarāṇām mahātmanām
rāmasya vyavasāyam ca vīryam praharaṇāni ca |
lakṣmaṇasya ca vīrasya tattvato GYātum arhatha
verses.translation: "Become unrecognisable to others, enter the army of monkeys and make out the real quantum of their army, their prowess, as to which monkeys are important among them, which ministers of Rama and Sugreeva have come together, which monkeys are abiding in front, which monkeys are valiant, how that bridge was constructed across the ocean full of water, how the encamping is done for those great-souled monkeys; the determination, strength and the striking senses of Rama and of the heroic Lakshmana."

verses.devanagari:
कः च सेना पतिस् तेषाम् वानराणाम् महाओजसाम् |
एतज् ज्ञात्वा यथा तत्त्वम् शीघ्रम् अगन्तुम् अर्हथः
verses.iast:
kaḥ ca senā patis teṣām vānarāṇām mahāojasām |
etaj GYātvā yathā tattvam śīghram agantum arhathaḥ
verses.translation: "Knowing also accurately who the Chief of Army of those high-souled monkeys is, you have to come back quickly."

verses.devanagari:
इति प्रतिसमादिष्टौ राक्षसौ शुक सारणौ |
हरि रूप धरौ वीरौ प्रविष्टौ वानरम् बलम्
verses.iast:
iti pratisamādiṣṭau rākṣasau śuka sāraṇau |
hari rūpa dharau vīrau praviṣṭau vānaram balam
verses.translation: Having thus been commanded by Ravana, the valiant demons Shuka and Sarana , both in the disguise of monkeys, entered that army of monkeys.

glosses.meaning: both possessing the form of monkeys

verses.devanagari:
ततस् तद् वानरम् सैन्यम् अचिन्त्यम् लोम हर्षणम् |
सम्ख्यातुम् न अध्यगच्चेताम् तदा तौ शुक सारणौ
verses.iast:
tatas tad vānaram sainyam acintyam loma harṣaṇam |
samkhyātum na adhyagaccetām tadā tau śuka sāraṇau
verses.translation: Shuka and Sarana were not able to count then that inconeviable army of monkeys, causing their hair to stand on end.

glosses.meaning: and causing their hair to stand erect.

verses.devanagari:
तत् स्थितम् पर्वत अग्रेषु निर्दरेषु गुहासु च |
समुद्रस्य च तीरेषु वनेषु उपवनेषु च
तरमाणम् च तीर्णम् च तर्तु कामम् च सर्वशः |
निविष्टम् निविशच् चैव भीम नादम् महाबलम्
तद्बलार्णवमक्षोभ्यम् ददृशाते निशाचरौ |
verses.iast:
tat sthitam parvata agreṣu nirdareṣu guhāsu ca |
samudrasya ca tīreṣu vaneṣu upavaneṣu ca
taramāṇam ca tīrṇam ca tartu kāmam ca sarvaśaḥ |
niviṣṭam niviśac caiva bhīma nādam mahābalam
tadbalārṇavamakśobhyam dadṛśāte niśācarau |
verses.translation: That army was stationed on the tops of mountains, round about the waterfalls, in the caves, on the sea-shores, in the woodlands and in the gardens. It was either in the process of crossing the ocean, or was intending to cross it in its entirety. It had either encamped or was still encamping, making a terrible noise. The two demons saw that very strong and imperturbable sea of army.

glosses.meaning: (It was either in) the process of crossing the ocen
or was intending to cross it

verses.devanagari:
तौ ददर्श महातेजाः प्रच्चन्नौ च विभीषणः
आचचक्षे अथ रामाय गृहीत्वा शुक सारणौ |
verses.iast:
tau dadarśa mahātejāḥ praccannau ca vibhīṣaṇaḥ
ācacakṣe atha rāmāya gṛhītvā śuka sāraṇau |
verses.translation: Vibhishana with great splendour beheld both of them in disguise. He caught hold of Shuka and Sarana and told Rama as follows:

verses.devanagari:
तस्यैतौ राक्षसेन्द्रस्य मन्त्रिणौ शुक्सारणौ
लंकायाः समनुप्राप्तौ चारौ पर पुरम् जयौ |
verses.iast:
tasyaitau rākśasendrasya mantriṇau śuksāraṇau
laṃkāyāḥ samanuprāptau cārau para puram jayau |
verses.translation: "O, Rama the conqueror of hostile citadels! These two demons are Shuka and Sarana, the ministers of Ravana and they came here as spies from Lanka."

verses.devanagari:
तौ दृष्ट्वा व्यथितौ रामम् निराशौ जीविते तदा
कृत अन्जलि पुटौ भीतौ वचनम् च इदम् ऊचतुः |
verses.iast:
tau dṛṣṭvā vyathitau rāmam nirāśau jīvite tadā
kṛta anjali puṭau bhītau vacanam ca idam ūcatuḥ |
verses.translation: Both of them, having seen Rama, were trembled with fear, without any hope for their lives and having joined their palms, spoke the following words:

verses.devanagari:
आवाम् इह आगतौ सौम्य रावण प्रहिताव् उभौ
परिज्ञातुम् बलम् कृत्स्नम् तव इदम् रघु नन्दन |
verses.iast:
āvām iha āgatau saumya rāvaṇa prahitāv ubhau
pariGYātum balam kṛtsnam tava idam raghu nandana |
verses.translation: "O, excellent man! O, Rama! We both of us, as sent by Ravana, came here together to know everything about your entire army."

verses.devanagari:
तयोस् तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा रामो दशरथ आत्मजः
अब्रवीत् प्रहसन् वाक्यम् सर्व भूत हिते रतः |
verses.iast:
tayos tad vacanam śrutvā rāmo daśaratha ātmajaḥ
abravīt prahasan vākyam sarva bhūta hite rataḥ |
verses.translation: Hearing their aforesaid words, Rama the son of Dasaratha who was interested in the welfare of all beings, smilingly spoke the following words:

glosses.meaning: in the welfare of all being

verses.devanagari:
यदि दृष्टम् बलम् कृत्स्नम् वयम् वा सुसमीक्षिताः
यथा उक्तम् वा कृतम् कार्यम् चन्दतः प्रतिगम्यताम् |
verses.iast:
yadi dṛṣṭam balam kṛtsnam vayam vā susamīkṣitāḥ
yathā uktam vā kṛtam kāryam candataḥ pratigamyatām |
verses.translation: "Has the entire army been observed by you? Have you observed us well? Have you accomplished the task, as entrusted to you? If so, you may go back now according to your free will."

glosses.meaning: yadi = been seen? vayam susamiikSitaH vaa = have we been seen well? kaaryam kR^itam vaa = has the operation been accomplished
as instructed? pratigamyataam = you may go back

verses.devanagari:
अथ किंचिददृष्टम् वा भूयस्तद्द्रष्टुमर्हथः
विभीषनो वा कार्त्स्न्येन पुनः संदर्शयिष्यति |
verses.iast:
atha kiṃcidadṛṣṭam vā bhūyastaddraṣṭumarhathaḥ
vibhīṣano vā kārtsnyena punaḥ saṃdarśayiṣyati |
verses.translation: "Even if you have not seen something you may see it now also. Otherwise, Vibhishana will show it to you again entirely."

glosses.meaning: even if you have not seen

verses.devanagari:
न चेदम् ग्रहम् णम् प्रप्य भेतव्यम् जीवितम् प्रति
व्यस्तशस्त्रौ गृहीतौ च न दूतौ वधमर्हतः |
verses.iast:
na cedam graham ṇam prapya bhetavyam jīvitam prati
vyastaśastrau gṛhītau ca na dūtau vadhamarhataḥ |
verses.translation: "You, having been caught, need not fear about your life. The captured messengers holding no weapons indeed deserve no killing."

verses.devanagari:
प्रच्चन्नौ च विमुञ्चएमौ चारौ रात्रिंच रावुभौ
शत्रुपक्षस्य सततम् विभीषण विकर्षिणौ |
verses.iast:
praccannau ca vimuJṇcaemau cārau rātriṃca rāvubhau
śatrupakśasya satatam vibhīṣaṇa vikarṣiṇau |
verses.translation: "O, Vibhishana! Always try to draw a bow-string on the opponents and not on these two demons. Set them both, who are spies in disguise, free."

verses.devanagari:
प्रविश्य नगरीम् लंकाम् भवद्भ्याम् धनद अनुजः
वक्तव्यो रक्षसाम् राजा यथा उक्तम् वचनम् मम |
verses.iast:
praviśya nagarīm laṃkām bhavadbhyām dhanada anujaḥ
vaktavyo rakṣasām rājā yathā uktam vacanam mama |
verses.translation: "When you return to the city of Lanka, repeat my words faithfully to Ravana the younger half-brother of Kubera and the king of demons."

glosses.meaning: Ravana the younger half-brother of Kubera the god of riches

verses.devanagari:
यद् बलम् च समाश्रित्य सीताम् मे हृतवान् असि
तद् दर्शय यथा कामम् ससैन्यः सह बान्धवः |
verses.iast:
yad balam ca samāśritya sītām me hṛtavān asi
tad darśaya yathā kāmam sasainyaḥ saha bāndhavaḥ |
verses.translation: "That force on which you relied when you were taking away Seetha from me, display that force at your will along with your troops and allies."

verses.devanagari:
श्वः काले नगरीम् लंकाम् सप्राकाराम् सतोरणाम्
राक्षसम् च बलम् पश्य शरैर् विध्वंसितम् मया |
verses.iast:
śvaḥ kāle nagarīm laṃkām saprākārām satoraṇām
rākṣasam ca balam paśya śarair vidhvaṃsitam mayā |
verses.translation: "Tomorrow, at break of day, you will see my arrows demolish the city of Lanka with its ramparts and arches as well as the army of demons."

verses.devanagari:
खोधम् भीममहम् मोक्ष्ये बलम् धारय रावण
श्वः काले वज्रवान् वज्रम् दानवेष्व् इव वासवः |
verses.iast:
khodham bhīmamaham mokṣye balam dhāraya rāvaṇa
śvaḥ kāle vajravān vajram dānaveṣv iva vāsavaḥ |
verses.translation: "O, Ravana! Tomorrow, at break of day I will cast my dreadful anger on you and your army as Indra the Lord of celestials wielding a thunderbolt casts the thunderbolt on demons."

verses.devanagari:
इति प्रतिसमादिष्टौ राक्षसौ शुक सारणौ
जयेति प्रतिनन्द्यैनम् राघवम् धर्मवत्सलम् |
आगम्य नगरीम् लंकाम् अब्रूताम् राक्षस अधिपम्
verses.iast:
iti pratisamādiṣṭau rākṣasau śuka sāraṇau
jayeti pratinandyainam rāghavam dharmavatsalam |
āgamya nagarīm laṃkām abrūtām rākṣasa adhipam
verses.translation: Receiving this command, the two demons, Shuka and Sarana, admiring his justice, cried out: "May you be victorious!", reached the city of Lanka and spoke to Ravana as follows:

glosses.meaning: "May you be Victorious!" enam = on this

verses.devanagari:
विभीषण गृहीतौ तु वध अर्हौ राक्षस ईश्वर |
दृष्ट्वा धर्म आत्मना मुक्तौ रामेण अमित तेजसा
verses.iast:
vibhīṣaṇa gṛhītau tu vadha arhau rākṣasa īśvara |
dṛṣṭvā dharma ātmanā muktau rāmeṇa amita tejasā
verses.translation: "O, king of demons! We were seized by Vibhishana with the intention of killing us. But, Rama, the pious minded wose valour is immeasurable, seeing us, set us free."

glosses.meaning: with the intention of killing us

verses.devanagari:
एक स्थान गता यत्र चत्वारः पुरुष ऋषभाः |
लोक पाल उपमाः शूराः कृत अस्त्रा दृढ विक्रमाः
रामो दाशरथिः श्रीमाम्ल् लक्ष्मणः च विभीषणः |
सुग्रीवः च महातेजा महाइन्द्र सम विक्रमः
एते शक्ताः पुरीम् लंकाम् सप्राकाराम् सतोरणाम् |
उत्पाट्य सम्क्रामयितुम् सर्वे तिष्ठन्तु वानराः
verses.iast:
eka sthāna gatā yatra catvāraḥ puruṣa ṛṣabhāḥ |
loka pāla upamāḥ śūrāḥ kṛta astrā dṛḍha vikramāḥ
rāmo dāśarathiḥ śrīmāml lakśmaṇaḥ ca vibhīṣaṇaḥ |
sugrīvaḥ ca mahātejā mahāindra sama vikramaḥ
ete śaktāḥ purīm laṃkām saprākārām satoraṇām |
utpāṭya samkrāmayitum sarve tiṣṭhantu vānarāḥ
verses.translation: "Where the four eminent persons who are equal to the protector of the worlds, the valiant ones skilled in the use of weapons and of proven prowess namely Rama the son of Dasaratha, the illustrious Lakshmana, the great resplendent Vibhishana and Sgreeva whose valour is equal to Indra the Lord of celestials, arestationed at the same place, they can pluck up the city of Lanka with its ramparts and arches and transplant it elswhere, even if all the monkeys keep aloof."

glosses.meaning: who are equal to the protector of the worlds
skilled in the use of weapons
whose valour is equal to that of Indra the Lord of celestials
are stationed at the same place

verses.devanagari:
यादृशम् तस्य रामस्य रूपम् प्रहरणानि च |
वधिष्यति पुरीम् लंकाम् एकस् तिष्ठन्तु ते त्रयः
verses.iast:
yādṛśam tasya rāmasya rūpam praharaṇāni ca |
vadhiṣyati purīm laṃkām ekas tiṣṭhantu te trayaḥ
verses.translation: "Such is Rama's form and such are his weapons, that he can alone overthrow the city of Lanka, his three other companious standing by."

verses.devanagari:
राम लक्ष्मण गुप्ता सा सुग्रीवेण च वाहिनी |
बभूव दुर्धर्षतरा सर्वैर् अपि सुर असुरैः
verses.iast:
rāma lakṣmaṇa guptā sā sugrīveṇa ca vāhinī |
babhūva durdharṣatarā sarvair api sura asuraiḥ
verses.translation: "That army protected by Rama and Lakshmana as well as Sugreeva, are exceedingly unconquerable even by all the gods and demons."

verses.devanagari:
प्रहृष्ट रूपा ध्वजिनी वन ओकसाम् |
वनौकसाम् सम्प्रति योद्धुम् इच्चताम् |
अलम् विरोधेन शमो विधीयताम् |
प्रदीयताम् दाशरथाय मैथिली
verses.iast:
prahṛṣṭa rūpā dhvajinī vana okasām |
vanaukasām samprati yoddhum iccatām |
alam virodhena śamo vidhīyatām |
pradīyatām dāśarathāya maithilī
verses.translation: "Now, the army of the mighty monkeys, who are readily inclined to fight, consists of cheerful warriors. Mae peace, insted of enmity with them. Restore Seetha to Rama."
